findings.message: Review `https://merchant.example/reviews/s-1002` at `$['data']['itemListElement'][1]['pagefront:reviewSubject']` declares `pagefront:reviewSubject` `product` on an Organization review sheet.
findings.remediation: A review on an Organization review sheet is about the seller by where it was collected: set `pagefront:reviewSubject` to `seller`. A review that is in fact about a product belongs in that product's review sheet. `unclassified` is never valid here, since the collection context is the classification.
